sql: with p as (  select market_ticker t, split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) ev, strategy, side, assumed_price px, quantity q, pnl, created_at  from paper_trades  where split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)='KXNFLTOTAL' and status in ('settled','closed_sl')    and strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and strategy not like '%\_pt%' and pnl is not null and quantity>0), mk as (  select p.ev, p.t, avg(px) px, 100*sum(pnl)/sum(q) cpc, bool_or(pnl<0) lost, min(p.created_at) c0,   extract(epoch from (min(s.close_time) - interval '48 hours' - min(p.created_at)))/3600 hk  from p left join mmsell_settlement_meta s on s.market_ticker=p.t group by 1,2), x as (  select ev, t, cpc, lost, 100-px tail,   case when 100-px<=7 then 'b6-7' when 100-px<=10 then 'c8-10' when 100-px<=20 then 'd11-20' else 'e>20' end band,   case when hk is null then 'z?' when hk>24 then 'a>24h pre' when hk>2 then 'b2-24h pre' when hk>0 then 'c0-2h pre'        when hk>-1.5 then 'd in 0-1.5h' when hk>-3 then 'e in 1.5-3h' else 'f in >3h' end clk,   case when c0 < '2026-09-09' then 'pre' else 'reg' end ph from mk), cells as (  select 'band.phase' dim, band||'.'||ph cell, ev, t, cpc, lost, tail from x  union all select 'clk(<=10c)', clk, ev, t, cpc, lost, tail from x where tail<=10  union all select 'clk.phase(<=10c)', clk||'.'||ph, ev, t, cpc, lost, tail from x where tail<=10  union all select 'phase(<=10c)', ph, ev, t, cpc, lost, tail from x where tail<=10), g as (select dim, cell, ev, sum(cpc)/100.0 gp from cells group by 1,2,3), gs as (select dim, cell, count(*) games, round(avg(gp)::numeric,4) mean_g, round((stddev_samp(gp)/sqrt(count(*)))::numeric,4) se_g,   count(*) filter (where gp<0) games_lost from g group by 1,2) select c.dim, c.cell, count(*) mkts, round(avg(c.tail),2) be_pct, round(100*avg(case when c.lost then 1 else 0 end),2) loss_pct,  sum(case when c.lost then 1 else 0 end) n_lost, round(avg(c.cpc),2) c_per_mkt, gs.games, gs.mean_g, gs.se_g, gs.games_lost from cells c join gs on gs.dim=c.dim and gs.cell=c.cell group by c.dim, c.cell, gs.games, gs.mean_g, gs.se_g, gs.games_lost order by 1,2
